summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the advanced package substrate / ABF node. The cleanest direct exposures are mostly non-US companies available through OTC ADRs or foreign ordinaries, while the US-exchange discovery lane is more second-order: OSAT capacity, advanced packaging tools, and substrate-fabrication equipment. The list deliberately includes only four names: two direct reference anchors, one US-listed advanced-packaging platform, and one small-cap equipment/speculative-shadow candidate.
